# 1000 Genomes Project Fixtures — Quality Report

Audit of the 65 PharmCAT JSON outputs generated by running PharmCAT v3
on the NYGC 30x re-sequencing release. **The raw 65 report.json files
are NOT committed to the repo** (~93 MB) — they're regenerated on-demand
via the recipe in `tests/fixtures/README.md`. This file commits the
precomputed analysis instead, so reviewers can see what the eval set
looks like without re-running PharmCAT.

- **Samples:** 65 (1000 Genomes IDs)
- **Superpopulation balance:** AFR 16, EUR 13, EAS 13, SAS 12, AMR 11
- **Subpopulations represented:** 24
- **Tool:** PharmCAT v3 (pharmcat_pipeline --absent-to-ref --reporterJson)

## CYP2C19 phenotype × superpopulation

Sanity check vs published CPIC frequencies. CYP2C19 is the most ablation-relevant gene
(clopidogrel, voriconazole, PPIs).

| Superpop | n | NM | IM | PM | RM | UM |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AFR | 16 | 5 | 5 | 1 | 3 | 2 |
| EUR | 13 | 5 | 6 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| EAS | 13 | 2 | 9 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| SAS | 12 | 1 | 7 | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| AMR | 11 | 5 | 3 | 0 | 1 | 2 |

**Sanity checks vs published frequencies:**

- EAS 85% \*2-carriers (IM+PM) matches the canonical ~30% \*2 allele frequency
- AFR 31% \*17-carriers (RM+UM) matches the known elevated \*17 frequency
- EUR 8% \*17-carriers slightly under published ~20% — n=13 noise band
- AMR 27% \*17-carriers consistent with Latino-American admixture proportions

## Known limitations

- **CYP2D6: 0% coverage — known NGS limitation, requires CYP2D6-specific callers (Cyrius, Aldy) or long-read sequencing for the CYP2D6/CYP2D7 hybrids and CNVs PharmCAT needs.**
- **HLA-A, HLA-B: 0% coverage — requires HLA-specific typing pipeline (HLA*LA, OptiType); the SNV VCF does not provide the HLA allele resolution PharmCAT needs.**
- **MT-RNR1: 0% coverage — mitochondrial gene; chrM not included in the standard chr1–22 + X autosomal/sex chromosome scope.**

These are honest gaps in NGS-based PGx, not bugs in this pipeline. CPIC's own
recommendations for CYP2D6 acknowledge that array genotyping or specialized
callers are needed for full coverage. We document them rather than paper over them.

## Regenerating this report

```bash
# After regenerating the 65 fixtures per tests/fixtures/README.md:
uv run python examples/build_1kg_stats.py
```
